_minFreeDiskGiBComment: The free space automatic agent work and the scheduled self-update hold to (DiskFloor.swift / diskfloor.py). 5 GiB: one more agent's worktree plus its npm ci is ~2 GiB, and macOS needs room for a few more 1 GiB swapfiles before a full disk freezes it. DIPLOMAT_MIN_FREE_DISK_MIB overrides it.
